description: This Java class defines a command handler for withdrawing a client transfer in the Fineract microfinance platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes transfer withdrawal commands, and interacts with TransferWritePlatformService to perform the operation.

classes.name: WithdrawClientTransferCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles withdrawal commands for client transfers by delegating to the transfer service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the withdrawal command for a client transfer, invoking the transfer service to perform the withdrawal.
